jobs.description:
Summary

At Places, we make things happen in service of all Apple employees and customers. Our team manages Apple's global real estate portfolio, capital construction projects, and workplace services, ensuring outstanding facilities, sustainability, and safety across our sites worldwide. As a Facilities Coordinator, you will play a vital role in creating and maintaining a seamless, productive workplace for Apple employees and visitors. In this role, you will be responsible for the day-to-day coordination and delivery of Soft Services across a portfolio of office buildings located in Munich and close to Stuttgart.

Description

Coordinate and oversee daily facility operations with a focus on Soft Services, including cleaning, reception, events, canteen, and vending services across multiple office locations. Manage vendor performance to ensure compliance with contractual Service Level Agreements (SLAs), quality standards, and Health & Safety requirements. Conduct regular site inspections to ensure facilities are maintained to corporate standards and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Serve as the primary point of contact for employees, vendors, landlords, and internal stakeholders, ensuring workplace services are delivered efficiently, safely, and in line with agreed service levels. Plan and coordinate small office refurbishment, fit-out, and minor construction projects, working closely with contractors, landlords, and internal stakeholders. Manage service requests through the Facilities Management system, ensuring timely follow-up and resolution. Coordinate office and lab moves, furniture changes, workspace reconfigurations, and occupancy updates. Ensure compliance with local regulations, company policies, and Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) standards. Build and maintain strong relationships with employees, business leaders, landlords, contractors, and service providers to deliver an outstanding workplace experience. Maintain compliance by managing tools, procedures, records, documentation, and invoice processing. Support Facility Managers with ad hoc requests and special projects. Work independently, take ownership, and consistently deliver high-quality results.

Minimum Qualifications

- Demonstrated experience in Facilities Management, with a strong focus on Soft Services within a corporate office environment.
- Experience managing multiple office locations or a regional property portfolio.
- Proven experience coordinating external service providers and managing vendor performance.
- Experience coordinating small office refurbishment, renovation, or workplace improvement projects.
- Fluency in German and English (written and spoken) is required.
- Proven experience managing and coordinating external technical resources (e.g., contractors, vendors) for facility-related projects, ensuring technical requirements are met on time and within budget.
- Valid driver's license and willingness to travel regularly between sites.
- Proven technical understanding and collaboration with technical team.

Preferred Qualifications

- Excellent organizational and planning skills.
- Strong customer service orientation and stakeholder management skills.
- Strong vendor and contract management capabilities.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
- Ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
- High attention to detail and commitment to quality.
- Project coordination experience.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Facilities Management, Business Administration, Engineering, Hospitality, or a related field.
- Proactive, collaborative approach to problem-solving.
- Continuous improvement mindset.
- Proficiency with iOS, macOS, and Microsoft Office.
- Willingness to learn new tools and integrate AI into daily work.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Facilities Management, Business Administration, Engineering, Hospitality, or a related field.

jobs.occupation: Machine Learning Compiler Engineer (M, F, D) #200677570 (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.employer_name: Apple Technology Services B.V. & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Summary

At Apple, we're on the cutting edge of delivering transformative experiences through Artificial Intelligence. If you're passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI and hardware optimization, we want you to join our team!

Description

As a Machine Learning Compiler Engineer on the Apple Neural Engine (ANE) team, you'll work to bring high-performance, low-power AI solutions to life on iconic Apple products like the Vision Pro, iPhone, iPad, Mac, and more. This is a dynamic opportunity to work with us in a creative, collaborative environment while developing groundbreaking technologies that will shape the future of computing. Are you ready to help us deliver the next groundbreaking Apple products?

Responsibilities

- Architect and develop the compiler for Apple's proprietary Neural Engine Accelerator, optimizing it for deep learning inference with a focus on performance, scalability, and power efficiency
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including hardware and platform architecture teams, to bring new hardware silicon to market and ensure compiler support for next-gen features
- Lead the design and implementation of complex compiler features, advancing both technical capabilities and strategic alignment across the team and company
- Play an instrumental role in defining new compiler architecture approaches and optimizations, balancing trade-offs between performance, energy efficiency, and hardware constraints
- Identify and drive initiatives that will improve the scalability and general performance of AI workloads on Apple hardware, contributing to the vision and roadmap of the Apple Neural Engine team

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field with 3 years of relevant experience
- Experience with program analysis and IR (Intermediate Representation), or programming language design, particularly with MLIR and LLVM
- Proven expertise in compiler design and architecture, including deep experience with front-end and middle-end optimizations, register allocation, and back-end code generation
- High-level proficiency in C++ and experience working with large, complex software systems
- Proficiency in English

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's or PhD degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field
- Demonstrated ability to ship high-quality production software
- Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively across teams and functions
- Experience optimizing compilers for distributed, parallel, or heterogeneous execution environments, with a solid understanding of shared memory, synchronization, and multi-threading techniques
- Expertise in neural network inference on specialized SoCs or GPUs, and knowledge of deep learning frameworks and tools
- Familiarity with Just-in-Time (JIT) compilation and dynamic optimization techniques for real-time code execution

Location: Munich | Full-time | Permanent

About us

We combine operational excellence with a strong team culture, short decision-making paths, and a modern IT environment that supports our growing international organization.

Senior Electrical Systems Engineer (m/f/d)

Instrumentation, Controls & Power Systems

Help Accelerate Industrial Decarbonization

Join exceptional people from around the world to solve some of the world's toughest energy challenges, make a real impact, and enjoy the adventure of building the future of industrial decarbonization together.

As our Senior Electrical Systems Engineer (m/f/d) – Instrumentation, Controls & Power Systems, you will play a key role in designing the electrical infrastructure that powers GlassPoint's next generation of solar thermal plants.

Working closely with colleagues across Mechanical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Systems Engineering, EPC partners, and suppliers, you will develop safe, reliable, and efficient electrical solutions for industrial-scale renewable energy facilities.

From concept development through commissioning, you'll contribute to projects that are shaping the future of industrial heat and energy.

Your Impact

In this role, you'll design electrical systems that enable the safe and efficient operation of some of the world's largest solar thermal facilities, supporting heavy industry on its journey toward decarbonization.

You'll combine technical expertise with systems thinking, working with internal teams, EPC partners, and global suppliers to develop robust, scalable electrical solutions that become part of our commercial projects worldwide.

What You'll Do

Design Electrical Systems

- Develop the conceptual design of electrical systems for solar thermal plants.
- Design and specify electrical heat tracing (EHT) systems, including piping, tanks, cable routing, junction boxes, and interfaces to plant control systems.
- Develop electrical architectures that support reliable, efficient, and safe plant operation.
- Ensure compliance with applicable international standards, regulations, and engineering best practices.

Develop Instrumentation & Control Systems

- Specify instrumentation including temperature, pressure, flow, and level measurement devices.
- Collaborate with Controls Engineering teams to define automation concepts, control philosophies, and system interfaces.
- Develop instrumentation and control (I&C) architectures for molten-salt solar thermal systems.
- Support the development of tracking algorithms, automation solutions, and electrical control strategies.

Engineering & Supplier Collaboration

- Select and specify electrical drive systems for solar collector tracking.
- Prepare technical specifications and tender documentation.
- Evaluate supplier solutions and support technical decision-making.
- Collaborate with engineering partners, control system providers, and equipment vendors throughout the project lifecycle.
- Manage technical interfaces and support successful project execution.

Support Project Delivery

- Support prototype development, testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting.
- Work collaboratively across disciplines to resolve technical challenges.
- Contribute to the development and improvement of electrical design standards and engineering processes.
- Provide technical expertise throughout all project phases, from concept development through commissioning.

Who You Are

You enjoy solving complex engineering challenges and designing reliable systems for demanding industrial environments. You combine strong technical expertise with a practical, solution-oriented mindset and have experience managing external partners and vendors. You thrive in multidisciplinary teams, communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and balance attention to detail with system-level thinking. Curious, collaborative, and eager to learn, you enjoy helping build engineering processes in a growing technology company while working both independently and as part of a team.

Ideally, you'll bring

- Master's degree (or equivalent) in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.
- Several years of experience designing electrical systems for industrial plants, renewable energy projects, power generation facilities, or process industries.
- Strong experience in electrical engineering, instrumentation, and control system design.
- Experience designing or specifying electrical heat tracing (EHT) systems and associated electrical infrastructure.
- Solid understanding of electrical power distribution and component selection.
- Experience with electrical drives, motors, and motion systems.
- Knowledge of industrial instrumentation, including temperature, pressure, flow, and level measurement technologies.
- Experience with process wiring, cable design, and electrical documentation.
- Understanding of low-voltage protection concepts and electrical safety principles.
- Experience creating technical documentation such as P&IDs, loop diagrams, and equipment specifications.
- Familiarity with international engineering standards such as IEC and VDE; knowledge of NEC is beneficial.
- Experience with PLC programming, industrial automation, or control software would be an advantage.
- Interest in microprocessor-based systems and edge controllers.
- Experience working with suppliers, contractors, or external engineering partners.
- Strong communication skills in English; German language skills are welcome but not required.

What You'll Find at GlassPoint

- Meaningful work that contributes directly to global decarbonization efforts with opportunities to take ownership and make an impact from day one.
- An inclusive, collaborative, and international working environment.
- Colleagues who support one another, share knowledge, and celebrate success together.
- Challenging projects that encourage innovation, growth, and continuous learning.

jobs.description:
Start Your Dental Career in Germany

We will support you on your journey to becoming a licensed dentist in Germany.

Have you graduated in dentistry outside Germany and dream of building your professional future here?

Are you looking for more than just a job? Do you want to become part of a friendly team that values you as a person and supports your professional development?

Then we would love to meet you.

About Us

We are a modern, family-owned dental practice located in the beautiful Northern Black Forest region of Germany.

Many of our patients have trusted us for years—often for generations. We know our patients personally, take time for them, and believe that excellent dentistry begins with trust and personal relationships.

We combine state-of-the-art technology with a warm and welcoming atmosphere.

Our practice offers:

- Digital dentistry
- CAD/CAM technology with same-day crowns
- High-quality prosthetic dentistry
- Modern diagnostics
- Professional preventive care
- A friendly and experienced team

We believe that exceptional quality requires time, dedication, and attention to every individual patient.

Your Career Path

We are looking for dentists from abroad who would like to complete their professional recognition and obtain their dental license in Germany.

You will begin working as a Dental Assistant while becoming familiar with the German healthcare system, our clinical procedures, and everyday practice.

During this time, we will actively support you throughout your recognition process until you achieve your goal of becoming a licensed dentist in Germany.

We already have experience successfully guiding an international dentist through this process and understand both the professional and personal challenges involved.

What We Offer

✔ Support during the professional recognition process

✔ A small and welcoming family-oriented team

✔ Modern equipment and digital workflows

✔ High-quality dentistry

✔ Excellent long-term career opportunities

✔ A respectful, supportive and appreciative working environment

An International Team

Moving to a new country can be challenging—but you won't be alone.

In our practice we speak:

🇩🇪 German

🇬🇧 English

Our team members also speak:

🇷🇺 Russian

🇺🇿 Uzbek

🇹🇷 Turkish

This multicultural environment helps many new colleagues feel comfortable from their very first day.

Live Where Others Spend Their Holidays

Our practice is located in one of Germany's most beautiful regions—the Northern Black Forest.

Here you'll enjoy:

- Beautiful forests and nature
- Excellent quality of life
- Safe and peaceful surroundings
- Easy access to Karlsruhe, Pforzheim and Stuttgart

Many international colleagues appreciate the relaxed lifestyle and welcoming community that our region offers.

Who We Are Looking For

You are a great fit if you:

- Graduated in Dentistry outside Germany
- Would like to build your future in Germany
- Minimum B1 German language level (better B2)
- Motivated to improve your German
- Enjoy working with people
- Are reliable, friendly and committed
- Appreciate teamwork and continuous learning

Let's Build Your Future Together

If you are looking for a practice that truly believes in your potential and wants to help you succeed, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Your journey to a successful dental career in Germany can begin here.

We look forward to getting to know you!
